questions.question: What promise did King Zedekiah and the people make, then break, in chapter 34?
options: To make a lasting peace with all the surrounding nations
To rebuild the broken walls of the holy city
To free their Hebrew slaves, then they took them back
To pay a heavy tribute to the king of Babylon
questions.answer: To free their Hebrew slaves, then they took them back

questions.question: What did God say their broken covenant would bring?
options: Peace and rest throughout the land
Liberty to sword, pestilence, and famine
A great harvest after the drought
questions.answer: Liberty to sword, pestilence, and famine

questions.question: God said Zedekiah would not die by the sword but in peace, yet would see the king of Babylon.
You took back the male and female slaves you had set at _____.
Behold, I proclaim to you liberty to the _____, to pestilence, and to famine.
